title: OTA Updates vs App Store Releases

scenes.line1: How do you ship updates fast?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how React Native apps get updates out quickly? Is it always through the app store, or can you push changes over the air?
Over-the-air updates let you push JavaScript and assets fast, skipping store approval. But native code changes still need a full app store release, which takes longer.
Here's how an over-the-air update goes. You make changes, publish them with Expo or CodePush, and users get the latest bundle when they open the app.

scenes.question: Can OTA update native code?
scenes.right: No, native changes need a store release. OTA is only for JavaScript and assets.
scenes.say: Interviewers love this one: Can you use over-the-air updates for native code? Nope, only JavaScript and assets. Native changes always need a store release.
